title: Junction coordinates for proper and open finite projection factors
statement: Fix D,C,E,m, a compactified six-functor morphism f:X→Y with c=(i,g), bounded constructible K on X, finite-Tor bounded constructible L on Y, ambient inputs U,V and isomorphisms k:U≅K.obj, l:V≅L.obj [def-sf-constructible-projection-mates]. The intrinsic projection is the proper and open/compositor word of SystemProjectionFormula.finiteProjection [lem-pur-system-level-projection-formula-coherence]. Define fixedProper and fixedTail as coefficient realization of the corresponding published fixed-scalar projection subwords [def-exchange-projection]. Define midpoint from the target of the intrinsic proper factor to the target of fixedProper using the specified tensor comparison [def-sf-canonical-finite-intrinsic-tensor-comparison] at c.Z, proper direct-image realization, open extension realization and exact/K-flat inverse-image realization; k and l transport the two fixed inputs. It uses no projection map or inverse projection. Then fixedProper followed by fixedTail is the realized published fixed projection, and its conjugate by sourceComparison and targetComparison is the included constructible component.

proof.text: Construct midpoint by applying proper direct image to the canonical tensor comparison at c.Z, then the normalized direct-image comparison, then proper direct image of the tensor of the explicit open and pullback coordinate isomorphisms. Construct the fixed pair of factors by their defining subwords. Functor.map_comp proves the fixed factorization; unfold the constructible conjugate and reassociate to prove component_factorization. For the fixed factorization apply the generic functorial image of the proper/open defining word. Compare definitionally equal coefficient-instance paths by cached congruence at argument boundaries; the resulting equality proofs are checked by the kernel, with the large derived functors kept abstract.

def midpoint (m : ℕ) {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (c : Compactification f.hom.left)
    (K : sixFunctorFiniteCategory D C E (m + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 m) X)
    (L : finiteTorConstructibleCategory C.l E (m + 1) (Nat.le_add_left 1 m) Y.obj.left)
    (U : normalizedDVRDerived C.l E X.obj.left m)
    (V : normalizedDVRDerived C.l E Y.obj.left m) (k : U ≅ K.obj) (l : V ≅ L.obj) :
    let A := Padic.coefficientExtensionRing C.l E (m + 1)
    let B := ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} A)
    let RX := realization (C := C) (E := E) (n := m + 1) (hn := Nat.le_add_left 1 m) X
    let RY := realization (C := C) (E := E) (n := m + 1) (hn := Nat.le_add_left 1 m) Y
    (proEtaleConstantDerivedDirectImage c.g A).obj
      ((finiteIntrinsicDerivedTensor C.l E c.Z m).obj
        (((sfIntrinsicExtensionByZero c.i A).mapDerivedCategory).obj U,
          (finiteDerivedPullback C.l E m c.g).obj V)) ⟶
      RY.functor.obj ((lowerStar B c.g).rightDerivedFunctor.obj
        (((derivedTensor B c.Z).obj
          ((openImmersionLowerShriek B c.i).mapDerivedCategory.obj
            (RX.inverse.obj K.obj))).obj
          ((upperStar B c.g).leftDerivedFunctor.obj (RY.inverse.obj L.obj))))
